description: This is a unit test class for the ThingDeleted class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains tests for immutability, equals and hashCode, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling.

classes.name: ThingDeletedTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for the ThingDeleted class, testing JSON serialization, immutability, equality, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the ThingDeleted class is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: fromJsonWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the fromJson method correctly parses JSON into a ThingDeleted object.
